correctness.rationale: The strongly regular identity gives exact (zero-sum) Laplacian inversion; coarea and induced-subgraph degree counting give every absolute column sum; strict diagonal bounds give the complementary projector identity. The explicit graph generators and edge-orbit counts prove the rational pair values. The standalone standard-library checker examines all 48 columns of each 16-vertex graph and cross-tests four further SRGs; a separate exact rational matrix computation confirmed idempotence, rank and all four norms. These finite checks corroborate, not substitute for, the all-SRG proof.

value.rationale: This is an all-connected-noncomplete-strongly-regular-graph structural theorem, not a one-off table. It pinpoints precisely the local induced-wing edge statistic ignored by SRG parameters and supplies a natural cospectral counterexample with a nonzero exact Banach operator-norm gap; it informs when spectral graph data can control absolute electrical-current localization.
